triggerReason: Redundant deployment-mode labels competed with city information, non-Observatory views lacked the intended cyberpunk atmosphere, and the existing theme selector did not provide a real light palette.
action: Removed observer-mode and software-run badges from rendered UI; replaced dark, hacker and matrix settings with persistent light and dark palettes; migrated old theme values safely; kept Human Observatory restrained while adding a shared multicolor cyberpunk atmosphere to every other view.
outcome: Release implementation f1b35a2 and Tag v4.3.1 at 0233ab7 passed the local gate and were deployed. The mandatory production-browser audit then found mixed transition colors and dynamic light-theme blue/green contrast ratios between 4.12:1 and 4.44:1. The release was not accepted as complete and is superseded by v4.3.2.
evidence: Tag v4.3.1 is retained as an immutable failed production-audit release
Production dynamic resident statuses exposed contrast cases absent from the Turn 0 local fixture
The production audit, not the earlier local claim, determines release acceptance
